name: ai-dev-assistant
description: Continuous edge-case & business-logic checker for JS/TS and Java

commands.title: AI Dev Assistant: Analyze Current File
AI Dev Assistant: Clear Analysis Cache
AI Dev Assistant: Store API Key (Secure)
AI Dev Assistant: List Rule IDs

aiDevAssistant.enableTier2.description: Enable LLM-assisted Tier-2 analysis (requires API keys)

aiDevAssistant.llmTimeout.description: Timeout in ms per LLM provider call (default 15000). Increase if you see timeout failures on large functions.

aiDevAssistant.groqApiKey.description: Groq API key (primary). Prefer using the 'AI Dev Assistant: Store API Key' command — that writes to VS Code's encrypted secret storage instead of plaintext settings.

aiDevAssistant.openRouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key (fallback 1). Prefer using the 'AI Dev Assistant: Store API Key' command for secure storage.

aiDevAssistant.geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key (fallback 2). Prefer using the 'AI Dev Assistant: Store API Key' command for secure storage.

aiDevAssistant.disabledRules.description: Rule IDs to suppress globally (e.g. ["loose-equality", "unvalidated-params"]). Run 'AI Dev Assistant: List Rule IDs' to see all available IDs.

aiDevAssistant.maxContextFiles.description: Maximum number of open workspace files included in cross-file callee resolution for Tier-2 context. Lower this if activation is slow.

chatParticipants.name: devassistant
chatParticipants.description: Ask about edge cases and business-logic issues in your code
